title: A novel digital health approach to improving global pediatric sepsis care in Bangladesh using wearable technology and machine learning.
summary: A prospective observational study of 100 children with sepsis in a Dhaka ICU used wearable vital signs and clinical data in ridge-regression models for advanced sepsis (pSOFA >8). The combined model had AUC .86, wearable-only AUC .78, and detected advanced sepsis about 2.5 hours before physician documentation.
ai_technology: Ridge-regression models combining wearable physiologic signals and clinical data to predict advanced sepsis.
